welcome.title: Learn in conversation.
welcome.lede: Learn a new language through quick, real conversations.

login.title: Log in
login.lede: Use the email and password for your Zipdeck account.

register.title: Continue with email
register.lede: This is the same account as Zipdeck.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.sent: A new code is on its way.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.start: Choose a scene to start the first one.
conversations.startLede: Hear a real conversation. Then say your line out loud.
conversations.sampleBody: You are the customer. {{native}} is the meaning. {{target}} is the line you say.
conversations.moreScenesHint: From the airport to a job interview
conversations.proPitchHome: Describe any situation. AI writes that conversation from your instructions.
conversations.proPitchShort: Describe any situation. AI writes it.
conversations.proEmptyLede: Pick a place, or describe your own. Each one uses a credit.

grades.practicingHint: You still want to practice this scene.
grades.learnedHint: You can play this scene without help.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.lede: Practice a ready-made scene, or create one of your own.
scenes.samplesLede: English on one side. Your language on the other.
scenes.samplesEnglish: Sample scenes are between English and another language.
scenes.createLede: Pick a place, or describe the one you need.
scenes.proPitch: Pro writes a conversation for a place you choose.
scenes.cafeLine: Order something and talk at the counter.
scenes.airportLine: Check in, ask about a bag, find the gate.
scenes.doctorLine: Say what hurts and answer a few questions.
scenes.hotelLine: Check in and ask for the room you want.
scenes.pharmacyLine: Ask for something when you do not know the name.
scenes.interviewLine: Introduce yourself and ask about the work.
scenes.restaurantLine: Ask for a table and order a meal.
scenes.taxiLine: Say where you are going and ask the fare.
scenes.supermarketLine: Find what you need and pay at the checkout.
scenes.directionsLine: Ask how to get somewhere nearby.
scenes.customPlaceholder: Talking about last night's football match with a friend
scenes.advancedHint: Quick scene, using your recent learned lessons.
scenes.buildOnHint: Pick up to 3. Leave them off to use your 5 most recent learned scenes.
scenes.buildOnOff: Turn on fully learned scenes above to choose which ones.
scenes.noLearned: No learned scenes in these languages yet.
scenes.includeWordsHint: Type a word in {{language}}. Check the translation, then add it. A word is used only when it fits the conversation.
scenes.wordLimitQuick: A quick scene can include 2 words.
scenes.wordLimitFull: A full scene can include 4 words.

practice.gradeWhole: {{title}}. Grade the whole scene, not each line.
practice.note: Fully learned is the one that stays with you. A later conversation can bring those words back. Still practicing keeps the scene in the list you are working through.
practice.turn: Turn {{current}} of {{total}}. You play the {{role}}. {{native}} is the meaning; {{target}} is the line to say.
practice.sampleDone: That’s the scene. You can listen to it again, or go back and try another.
practice.voiceUnsupported: No voice is installed for this language.

listen.title: Listen
listen.lede: Hear both sides of a conversation, with a pause before the next line.
listen.sampleBody: A coffee order, played straight through.
listen.plays: Plays the line, then the meaning.
listen.end: That’s the end of the scene.
listen.sleepHint: Listening stops when this time is up.
listen.blocked: Tap play to start the audio.

me.proOn: Pro is on for this account. It works in Zipdeck and ZipCONVO.
me.proOff: This account does not have Pro yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Appearance, language, and listening are saved on your account.
settings.changeEmailHint: We email a code to the new address. The login changes only after you enter that code.
settings.emailCodeSent: Enter the code we sent to {{email}}.
settings.googleEmail: This account signs in with Google, so the email stays the one on that Google account.
settings.appleEmail: This account signs in with Apple, so the email stays the one on that Apple ID.
settings.languageHint: This language is used in ZipCONVO and on your Zipdeck account.
settings.listeningHint: These choices are used when a conversation plays.

cards.title: Flashcards
cards.makeLead: Make a deck from the lines in this conversation.
cards.makeExplain: One card for each line. {{native}} is the front. {{target}} is the back.
cards.noneDue: Nothing is due in this deck right now.
cards.needBoth: Enter a front and a back.
cards.emptyDeck: This deck has no cards yet.
cards.noLines: This conversation has no lines to turn into cards.
cards.gone: This deck is no longer available.

errors.deckNameTaken: You already have a deck with that name
errors.samplesEnglish: Samples are to and from English

pro.subtitleAccount: Pro is on for this account in Zipdeck and ZipCONVO.
pro.renewNote: Renews until you cancel. Cancel anytime in the store.
pro.comingSoon: Subscribe in the ZipCONVO app on Android or iPhone.
pro.featureGenerateDetail: Describe a scene, or start from one of the places, and the app writes a new conversation.
pro.featureCreditsDetail: Each generated conversation, and each Zipdeck AI deck, uses one shared credit. Unused monthly credits reset next month. Extra credits you buy stay until you use them.
pro.featureSharedDetail: A Pro purchase in ZipCONVO or Zipdeck turns Pro on for the same account.
pro.accountIntro: Pro is active on this account.
pro.restoreHint: Use this if you already subscribed on this phone.
pro.restoreNone: No purchases were found for this account.
